items.name: Blindowy Piątkowy Wieczór w Gdańsku 2025
items.information: Witajcie na blindowych piątkowych wieczorowych zawodach w Gdańskim schronisku! Zapraszamy wszystkich zawodników na cichy pojedynek w konkurencji 3x3 bez patrzenia. Następnego dnia, w gdańskiej dzielnicy Zaspa, odbędzie się [Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu V 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GdanskaLigaSpeedcubinguV2025), na którą również serdecznie zapraszamy. --- Welcome to the blind friday evening competition in the Gdańsk's Youth Hostel! We invite all competitors to a quiet competition in the 3x3 blindfolded event. The following day, in the Gdańsk district of Zaspa, the [Gdańsk Speedcubing League V 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GdanskaLigaSpeedcubinguV2025) will take place – you're warmly invited to join us there as well.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. O uso de máscaras é recomendado! Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff. The use of facial masks is recommended

items.information: 🟥🟨🟩 **¡Bienvenidos al Campeonato Nacional de Bolivia 2026!** 🟥🟨🟩 Este campeonato celebra los 10 años desde que Bolivia organizó su primer Campeonato Nacional, un evento que dio inicio al crecimiento del speedcubing en nuestro país. Desde entonces, nuestra comunidad no ha dejado de crecer, reuniendo a personas de todas las edades y de diferentes regiones, unidas por la pasión por el Speedcubing, el desafío de superar sus propios tiempos y el de compañerismo que caracteriza a la comunidad del speedcubing. Hoy queremos celebrar todo ese camino recorrido con una edición muy especial. La inscripción está abierta para todos, sin importar la edad ni el lugar de donde vengan. ¡Anímate a ser parte de esta celebración y vive un campeonato que quedará en la historia del speedcubing en Bolivia! 🟥🟨🟩 **¡Welcome to the Bolivia National Championship 2026!** 🟥🟨🟩 His championship celebrates 10 years since Bolivia hosted its very first National Championship, the event that helped kick off the growth of speedcubing in our country. Since then, our community has kept growing, bringing together people of all ages and from all over the country who share a passion for the Speedcubing, chasing new personal bests, and the amazing sense of community that makes speedcubing so special. We're excited to celebrate this journey with a very special edition of the championship. Registration is open to everyone, no matter your age or where you're from. Come join us, meet fellow cubers, and be part of a championship that will make speedcubing history in Bolivia! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjA2MDQ0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c0d143d39819bad425907a01d1201cca236592fa/BN26%20-%20WCA%20-%20%20Banner.png)

items.information: **Español** • “Boquete Big Cubes 2022” será la cuarta competencia oficial en Chiriquí. • Con protocolos de Bioseguridad nacionales y los establecidos por la WCA. items.information: **Português** Será um prazer recebê-los e temos algumas dicas para vocês, competidores e acompanhantes: - Chegue ao local da competição 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. A nossa competição é formada por alguns competidores experientes, mas sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. - Procure se divertir bastante! #### ATENÇÃO ##### É obrigatório o preenchimento do seguinte formulário com o nome do competidor e dos acompanhantes para entrar no condomínio. Caso não preencha até o fim do período de inscrições não será possível entrar no local. [link do Formulário](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdwWJDXUOqw9hSGDnEH6aVKbNqFOBlrLukNSABQ1yUAAhk1aQ/viewform) **English** It will be a pleasure to receive you and we have some tips for you, competitors and companions: - Arrive at the competition site 30 minutes before the modality that will participate; - The cube you will be competing in must be in good condition, so take good care of it; - At the time of the awards, at the end of Sunday, we will draw some cubes for the competitors. Only win who is present and no one can win twice; - If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubists. - Try to have a lot of fun! #### ATTENTION ##### It is mandatory to fill in the following form with the name of the competitor and companions to enter the condominium. If you don't complete it by the end of the registration period, will not be able to enter the site. [form link](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdwWJDXUOqw9hSGDnEH6aVKbNqFOBlrLukNSABQ1yUAAhk1aQ/viewform)

items.information: We're excited to welcome competitors back to Boulder for another fun day of speedcubing! Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. These tabs include important information regarding your responsibilities as a competitor and are very important! This competition has a 100 competitor limit. Please try to limit your guests that you bring to the competition! Competitions fill quickly, so it is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first competition, please be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:20 AM. If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team, to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete. You will receive a 50 percent refund if you drop before the withdrawal deadline of (12:00 AM UTC 12-31-2024) This competition is financially supported by Colorado Cubers!

venue.name: Brasil Nihon Kiin
venue.address: R. Dr. Fabrício Vampré, 116 - Vila Mariana, São Paulo - SP, 04014-020

items.information: ##Português: **Competidores, atenção aos seguintes avisos:** - Esta competição *não terá a modalidade* ***3x3x3*** ; - Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem **certeza que irá participar**. Em caso de desistência, por favor **entrar em contato com a organização**; - O competidor poderá se inscrever antecipadamente pelo site e sua inscrição será confirmada apenas com o pagamento da taxa via PIX: **fbgrac@gmail.com**, após isso enviar comprovante para o mesmo e-mail, contendo o print do comprovante e o nome do competidor. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. **Caso o limite de 28 competidores não seja atingido, estaremos aceitando inscrições no local pelo preço de R$21, por ordem de chegada** ##English: **Competitors, heed the following warnings:** - This competition *will NOT have* the ***3x3x3*** event; - This competition will have a limit on competitors. Register only if you are **sure that you will participate**. In case of withdrawal, please **contact the organization**; - The competitor may register in advance on the website and their registration will only be confirmed upon payment of the fee via PIX: **fbgrac@gmail.com**, after which send proof of registration to the same email, containing the print of the proof of registration and the name of the competitor. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said in WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff. **If the competitor limit of 28 isn't reached, we will be accepting on the spot registrations for the price of R$21, in order of arrival**

items.name: Brisbane Newcomers 2025
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTA1MjAsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--55408dbefbb5feb13afb7ffe66780bb1d10da0f3/WCA%20Newcomer%20Month%202025.png)This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Registrations will be accepted based on the following: * 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. * Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. * If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. * If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. **Contact us** We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)! [Speedcubing Australia Website](https://speedcubing.org.au) Speedcubing Australia acknowledges the traditional owners of this land, the Quandamooka people, and pays respect to the elders, past and present for they hold the memories, the traditions, the culture and hopes of Aboriginal Australia.

items.information: ### 대회 참가비 결제를 완료하였더라도 선착순에 의해 정원에 들지 못하면 대회 참가가 불가능합니다. ### 참가 확정 / 대기 명단은 3일 내로 갱신되니, 참가 신청 이후 명단에서 본인의 이름을 확인해 주시기를 바랍니다. ### 주최 측에서 발송하는 이메일을 꼭 확인 하시기를 바랍니다. 모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)을 숙지하여야 합니다. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. 원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오. 원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [WCA 규정 및 타이머 사용 안내 영상](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1)을 시청하여 주십시오. ___ ### Even if you successfully paid the registration fee, due to the first-come first-served basis for registration, you might be put on the waitlist. ### Within 3 days of paying the registration fee, you should be able to see your name on either the competitor list or waitlist. ### Please be sure to check the emails sent by the organizers. All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Due to the WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties if requested by organizers. Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1) if you are not familiar with the official WCA competition.

items.name: Brugge Beginners Open 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb3RoIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--56c666b653d5d49a04769be1350747cbef8b23a2/newwcomer-month.jpg) This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024. **The registration process will reserve 50 spots for new competitors.** New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. **Your registration is only complete after paying the registration fee via the WCA website. Registrations will be accepted based on the moment of payment.** **Registrations will be accepted based on the following:** * 50 spots are reserved for new competitors. * Initially, 100 spots are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. * If more than 50 new competitors register before 100 spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. * If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBajBqIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--7beabe32163b26aed8c733e5c7562315ef48ade7/image.png) ¡Bienvenidos al **Buenos Aires Cubea 2022**! Este será un torneo enfocado en reunir competidores de todas partes del país debido a la gran capacidad del lugar. Habrá dos salones donde se realizarán las rondas simultáneamente. Este torneo consta de 10 categorías donde se dará más prioridad a las categorías más populares, teniendo así 4 rondas de 3x3 por primera vez en Argentina. Pedimos a los competidores nuevos que se familiaricen con el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) y se presenten al menos 15 minutos antes del registro y para cualquier categoría en la que participen. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBajRqIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a5a15438d910a9c0341cea28270f233e50066202/image.png) Welcome to **Buenos Aires Cubea 2022**! This will be a competition focused on gathering competitors from every part of the country due to the large capacity of the venue. There will be two rooms where the rounds will be held simultaneously. This competition consists of 10 events with more priority given to more popular events, thus having 4 rounds of 3x3 for the first time in Argentina. We ask new competitors to familiarize themselves with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) and to show up at least 15 minutes prior to registration and for any event in which they participate.

The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Tuesday, December 14th is insufficient for entrance to the competition.** You may submit your documents early by submitting them to this [form](https://forms.gle/pYBXzKcyr2pKmULw5)

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjEyNDgzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e88ce5718f2045f0e748da68cc0c5f3f442c3f38/WhatsApp%20Image%202026-09-02%20at%2015.56.14.jpeg) Bem-vindos ao CAU ao Cubo 2026, em Itajaí! Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba Inscrever. Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8). Favor ler o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição. Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para o feminino, novatos, seniores e alunos do CAU na modalidade 'Cubo 3x3x3'. A premiação extra-oficial será feita de acordo com a classificação do competidor na competição. (não será definida apenas pela primeira rodada). A premiação extra-oficial dos alunos do CAU será feita de acordo com uma pontuação geral entre todas as modalidades, e será dividida entre Ensino Fundamental I, Ensino Fundamental II e Ensino Médio. Inscrições no local serão aceitas apenas para os eventos do segundo dia (3x3x3, 2x2x2, Pyraminx e 3x3x3 OH). Por gentileza, esteja no local com no mínimo 1 hora de antecedência. 🇺🇸 Welcome to the CAU ao Cubo 2026, competition in Itajaí! Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the Register tab. If you have any difficulties with registration, take a look at this [video](https://youtu.be/4yo7IqbcgOA?si=SJNiCFCSh-eLN550). Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. We will have awards for all official events, as well as unofficial awards for women, beginners, seniors, and CAU students in the '3x3x3 Cube' event. The unofficial awards will be given according to the competitor's position in the competition (they will not be based solely on the first round results). The unofficial awards for CAU students will be based on an overall score across all events and will be divided into Elementary School I, Elementary School II, and High School. On-site registration will be accepted only for the events on the second day (3x3x3, 2x2x2, Pyraminx, and 3x3x3 One-Handed). Please arrive at the venue at least 1 hour in advance.

items.information: ¡Formá parte de este nuevo torneo! items.information: 🇧🇷 Estamos ansiosos para recebê-los e queremos compartilhar algumas dicas importantes para os competidores e acompanhantes: - **Sua inscrição será confirmada no site da WCA assim que o pagamento for confirmado e o comprovante for enviado.** Para mais informações, acesse a aba de [Inscrição](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CEMSaoCuboVilaVelha2025/register); - Recomendamos chegar ao local da competição pelo menos 30 minutos antes do início da modalidade em que você irá participar; - Certifique-se de que o cubo que você usará na competição esteja em boas condições, pois cubos danificados podem ser recusados; - Estamos aqui para ajudar! Se você tiver alguma dúvida, fique à vontade para perguntar; - Se este for o seu primeiro campeonato, assista a [este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU); - Antes da competição, leia as [Regulamentações da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) para estar familiarizado com as regras; - Divirta-se e aproveite ao máximo! ------------------------------------- 🇺🇸 We are excited to welcome you and want to share some essential tips for competitors and companions: - **Your registration will be confirmed on the WCA website as soon as the payment is confirmed and the receipt is sent.** For more information, visit the [Registration](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CEMSaoCuboVilaVelha2025/register) tab; - We recommend arriving at the competition venue at least 30 minutes before the start of the event you will participate in; - Make sure that the cube you will use in the competition is in good condition, as damaged cubes may not be accepted; - We are here to assist you! items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTA2MDU5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--9099699a415c4020c460b8848aaf69949ce677ba/goes%20crazy%20wca.png) Drodzy, ekipa Cube Factory pragnie serdecznie zaprosić na jedyne w swoim rodzaju zawody side'owe! Chcemy dać Wam możliwość sprawdzenia swoich sił w konkurencjach blindowych oraz Big Cube'ach bez ciążącego na Was widma restrykcyjnych cut-offów, które zastąpione zostały wysokimi limitami kumulowanymi. Dzięki temu mniej zaawansowani zawodnicy będą mieli szansę na uzyskanie wyników których wcześniej nie byli w stanie osiągnąć! Oszaleliśmy? Być może 😉 Dear All, Cube Factory Team invites you to a unique side-events competition! We want to give you a chance to try your luck in big cubes and blinfolded events, without the strict cut-offs looming over you. Instead, we have replaced them with very generous cumulative time limits. This way, less experienced competitors will finally have a shot at achieving results that used to be out of reach! Have we Gone Crazy? Maybe 😉 ---- **WAŻNE / IMPORTANT** Ze względu na duży limit kumulowany dla konkurencji 4x4x4 Blindfolded oraz 5x5x5 Blindfolded doświadczeni zawodnicy mają możliwość rozpoczęcia swoich prób w trakcie trwania rundy. W takim wypadku, zgodnie z punktem 2u2) regulaminu WCA, zawodnikowi zostanie zmniejszony limit kumulowany o czas odpowiadający czasowi spóźnienia. Konkurencja 3x3x3 wiele kostek bez patrzenia posiada oddzielny limit zawodników, który wynosi 16. Konkurencja 4x4x4 bez patrzenia posiada oddzielny limit zawodników, który wynosi 16. Konkurencja 5x5x5 bez patrzenia posiada oddzielny limit zawodników, który wynosi 16. 3x3x3 Multi-Blind has a separate competitiors limit of 16. 4x4x4 Blindfolded has a separate competitiors limit of 16. 5x5x5 Blindfolded has a separate competitiors limit of 16.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk1NzE4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d2b53712ac871ab6dd62d8e0a7492a029417cfaa/logo-cec-1.jpg) **🇧🇷 Português:** A competição é aberta a participantes de todas as idades. As inscrições devem ser realizadas exclusivamente pelo site da WCA, mediante pagamento antecipado da taxa via PIX. A inscrição será confirmada apenas após a validação do pagamento. Para garantir o bom andamento do evento, ao se inscrever em uma modalidade você também assume o compromisso de atuar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria, conforme estabelecido pelas regras da WCA. Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, com as responsabilidades divididas entre todos os competidores. Em cada modalidade haverá, no mínimo, dois grupos: em um deles você competirá e, no outro, ajudará como juiz ou embaralhador. Ao efetuar sua inscrição, você autoriza a AACM, a WCA e seus parceiros a utilizarem gratuitamente sua imagem em fotos e filmagens realizadas durante o evento, inclusive para fins comerciais. --- **🇺🇸 English:** The competition is open to participants of all ages. Registrations must be made exclusively through the WCA website, with the entry fee paid in advance via PIX. Registration will only be confirmed after payment validation. To ensure the smooth running of the event, by registering for an event you also commit to serving as a judge or scrambler in that category, as established by the WCA regulations. In this way, the competition becomes self-sustainable, with responsibilities shared among all competitors. For each event, there will be at least two groups: in one you will compete, and in the other you will serve as a judge or scrambler. By completing your registration, you authorize AACM, WCA, and their partners to freely use your image in photos and videos taken during the event, including for commercial purposes.

We want your experience to go beyond the competition: we want it to also be an encounter with our roots, our stories, and our music. We look forward to seeing you in San José Iturbide to continue building the **"Caminos de Guanajuato"** together. This competition is recognized as an official competition of the **World Cube Association**. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the[ WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) prior to competition. **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTEzOTc3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bde9ec161a7bab04eccdb3fc3331c34ff2b36f13/BAIANO%202025%20copiar.jpg) # Português ​ A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. ​ Visando o bom andamento da competição, **ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador** nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram previstos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos, você compete; no outro, deverá ajudar a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. ​ **ATENÇÃO:** Competidores **menores de 18 anos devem estar acompanhadas por um responsável**. Ressaltamos que a competição ocorrerá em um espaço público, e a organização não se responsabiliza pela supervisão das crianças. ​ **COMPETIDORES NOVATOS** devem asssitir [a este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU&pp=ygUPYWJyYWNtIHR1dG9yaWFs) para aprender como competir em uma competição oficial de Cubo Mágico. **Não haverá tutorial para competidores novatos no dia da competição** ​ As inscrições custam R$ 30,00 (trinta reais) a serem pagos antes do campeonato. A sua inscrição só será aceita após o cumprimento de todas as etapas de inscrição (pagamento e envio do comprovante por e-mail). ​ O pagamento da inscrição dá direito a um acompanhante. Convidados e espectadores, inclusive os responsáveis por menores de 18 anos, devem pagar uma taxa de R$ 10,00 (dez reais) para poderem ingressar no evento. ​ Menores de 5 anos estão isentos de taxas ​ Inscrições no local serão aceitas no valor de R$ 40,00 (quarenta reais), caso haja vagas. ​ Acompanhantes e espectadores poderão comprar seu ingresso no dia pelo valor de R$ 15,00 (vinte reais), caso haja vagas. ​ # English ​ Registration is open to any person, from any country. ​ To ensure the smooth running of the competition, **by registering for an event, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler** in that event (as provided by the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming overwhelming for just a few. Each event will have at least two groups for each event. In one of the groups, you compete; in the other you should help to scramble or as a judge. ​ **ATTENTION:** Competitors **under 18 must be accompanied by a guardian**. Please note that the competition will take place in a public space, and the organization is not responsible for supervising children. ​ **FIRST TIME COMPETITORS** must watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU&pp=ygUPYWJyYWNtIHR1dG9yaWFs) In order to learn how to compete in an official Rubik's Cube competition. **No tutorial for newcomers will occur at the competition** ​ Registration costs R$30.00 (thirty Brazilian reais) to be paid in advance. Your registration will only be accepted once all the registration steps have been completed (payment and sending of proof by e-mail, with all the information required). ​ Payment of registration fee guarantees the competitor a single companion. Guests and spectators, including the guardians of people under 18, must pay a fee of R$10.00 to enter the event. ​ People under 5 years are exempt from the guest fee ​ On-site registrations will be accepted for R$40.00 (fourty Brazilian reais), if there are still places. ​ Guests and spectators can buy their tickets on the day for R$20.00 (twenty Brazilian reais), if there are still places. ​

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTAwMTA4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--daef33d7ae3aafcc06a39fef90bb4a22af1db024/WhatsApp%20Image%202025-06-03%20at%2019.29.40.jpeg) **ENGLISH** Welcome to the Cantoya Open Paracho 2025! This official WCA competition will take place in the charming Pueblo Mágico of Paracho, Michoacán, a town known for its rich craftsmanship and warm cultural heritage. The event will be held during the internationally renowned Cantoya Balloon Festival, a celebration filled with color, creativity, and tradition that attracts visitors from around the world. This edition of the competition will feature the following official events: 3x3x3, 3x3x3 One-Handed, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 4x4x4, Pyraminx, and Skewb. It promises to be an unforgettable experience for both competitors and guests, blending the excitement of speedcubing with one of Mexico’s most vibrant cultural festivals. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/). **ESPAÑOL** ¡Bienvenidos al Cantoya Open Paracho 2025! Este torneo oficial de la WCA se llevará a cabo en el encantador Pueblo Mágico de Paracho, Michoacán, famoso por su tradición artesanal y su calidez cultural. La competencia se celebrará durante el reconocido Festival Internacional de Globos de Cantoya, un evento lleno de color, creatividad y tradición que reúne a visitantes de todo el mundo. En esta edición del torneo se disputarán las siguientes categorías oficiales: 3x3x3, 3x3x3 One Handed, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 4x4x4, Pyraminx y Skewb. Será una experiencia inolvidable tanto para competidores como para acompañantes, combinando lo mejor del speedcubing con una de las celebraciones culturales más importantes de México. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/).

items.name: Cape Cubes Challenge 2024
items.information: CubingZA is excited to announce the final Cape Town competition for 2024 - Cape Cubes Challenge! This competition will focus on a variety of popular events across two days. Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" section, and pay for your entry. Please see **Registration Requirements** below. Please keep in mind that we **will not** be accepting on-the-day registration. We are going to be using printed nametags and the Competition Groups website for competitor roles and duties and to do this we will need to close the registration period before the competition begins. A huge thanks to [Speedcubes](www.speedcubes.co.za) for sponsoring this competition! Please see the Sponsors tab for more information, and make sure to support the Speedcubes shop at the competition. ![Speedcubes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc5NDUsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--f899ecbbd498c3dd38ea30276772dcc02470011a/NEW_SPEEDCUBE_LOGO_BLACK.webp) **SPECTATORS** Competitors are welcome to bring up to two spectators with them. **VOLUNTEERING** Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8).

items.name: Cape Cubes Spring 2025
items.information: ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind. ## NOTICE FOR COMPETITORS Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time. ## NOTICE OF FILMING Please note that there will be filming and photography at this event. You therefore consent to your image being used by CubingZA and its partners in their marketing and social media platforms by attending.

items.name: Cape Cubes Winter 2025
items.information: Welcome to Cape Cubes Winter 2025! This competition will focus on a variety of popular events across two days, with a brand new format where we will do all the rounds of each event in a row, then move onto another event. Please look at the Schedule to see what this looks like, and when your events are due to begin. Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" section, and pay for your entry. On-the-spot registration will be accepted, but it is still a good idea to register and pay online. Please see **Registration Requirements** below. ​ **SPONSOR** A huge thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za/) for sponsoring this competition! Please see the Sponsors tab for more information, and make sure to support the Cubestuff shop at the competition. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTAwODIwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6f6279e9aecc7732beb40546a8e15830a644dfd6/cubestufflogocolourv2-2048x800.png) ​ **SPECTATORS** Spectators are welcome and can attend for free! Bring your family and friends to support! ​ **VOLUNTEERING** Please note that **all competitors** are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). ​ **IMPORTANT NOTE ON VOLUNTEERING ASSIGNEMENTS** Please also check [Competition Groups](https://www.competitiongroups.com/) to see what groups you are in for competing as well as your running, judging and scrambling assignments. If you cannot make any of your assignments, it is **your** responsibility to find a replacement, and you must have a good reason for not being around for your assignment. Keep Competition Groups open during the day to ensure you never miss an assignment accidentally.

items.information: Capital Cube 2017 will be the second tournament of this year, starting this 2017 year willing to make Speed Cubing community grow in Venezuela, invinting new people to join this great and big world, using the Rubik's Cube fame and people's curiosity about learning to solve it, developing mental strength, dextery and talent we all have... The reason for this tournament is to let the people know abous our Caracas community to help us grow... The tournament will be held on a very good space with good lights with several chairs and tables to set up the event, with good temperature, sound and all we need to handle the event and make upcoming tournament possible and better, the schedule its focused on new people and to be realized in a good and calm way so we end every puzzle competition on time, we will held 7 categories: 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, 5x5, 3x3 OH, Pyraminx and Rubik's Clock, the current Rubik's Clock SAR holder will join us and other current National Holder Records, the final point is to have a good tournament and set ground for the next. Torneo Capital Cube 2017 será el segundo torneo del año de Venezuela, empezando este 2017 con ansias de hacer crecer el Speed Cubing en Venezuela invitando a gente nueva para que se una a este grande y genial mundo, aprovechando la fama de los cubos de rubik y la curiosidad de la gente por aprender, y desarrollar la habilidad mental, destreza y el talento escondido que todos tenemos... La finalidad de este torneo es principalmente para darnos a conocer un poco más en el país y hacer que crezca la comunidad... El lugar de el evento será una sala bastante espaciosa e iluminada que contará con numerosas mesas y sillas para los competidores, con aire acondicionado, micrófono y todo lo necesario para hacer de este evento un buen abre boca para los que se vienen en el transcurso de el año, el cronograma está pensado para que todas las categorías se realicen de una forma calmada y ordenada para que el evento termine en el a la hora determinada y sin contratiempos, serán siete categorías: 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, 5x5, OH,Pyraminx & Clock y contaremos con la presencia de el SAR de clock, y otros participantes con NR actuales, la idea es que todo salga perfectamente y este torneo sea solo una base para torneos mucho más grandes.

items.information: **(Português) Brasileiro** É com grande alegria que anunciamos o retorno do Capivara! A partir desse ano, pretendemos trabalhar com doações para fins filantrópicos, assim, além de nos divertirmos, também ajudamos a fazer um mundo melhor. Estamos trabalhando em conjunto com o [LEO e Lions](https://www.lionsclubs.org/) para arrecadar brinquedos e alimentos para crianças carentes, então todo o lucro da competição será revertido para essa campanha. Além disso, se você quiser fazer uma doação no dia, também será muito bem-vinda. Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição". Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=hfp2rKaN8jHPI_RL). É muito importante que você conheça todo o regulamento, que podem ser lido [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/). Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para as modalidades 'Feminino' e 'Iniciante', que tomarão como referência a classificação geral na modalidade '3x3x3'. **English** It is in great excitement that we announce the return of Capivara! From this year on, we intend to work with donations for philanthropic purposes, therefore, in addition to having fun, we can also help make a better world. We are working together with [LEO and Lions](https://www.lionsclubs.org/) to collect toys and food to children in need, so all profit from the competition will be directed to that campaign. Besides that, if you would like to give a donation on the spot, it will also be very welcome. Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements". If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://youtu.be/dZQiw5v8Bm0?si=6Yf5Zun_nlTfECTy). It is very important that you know the regulations, which may be read [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards to the events 'Female' and 'Beginner', which will consider the final ranking in the '3x3x3' event.

items.information: 🇧🇷 O Capixaba Challenge 2023 é o 15º Campeonato Oficial do Espírito Santo. items.information: ##### 🇧🇷 Seja bem vindo ao **Cascavel ao Cubo 2026**! Instruções de participação: * Todas as informações sobre inscrição no evento podem ser encontradas na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CascavelaoCubo2026/register). * As inscrições vão até o dia **02/10/2026**, ou até que o **limite de 50 competidores** seja atingido. Após essa data, só será possível a inscrição no dia do campeonato, caso haja vagas remanescentes. * Chegue ao local da competição, com seu cubo em mãos, no mínimo 30 minutos antes do horário de qualquer modalidade que você participará. * Todos os participantes devem ler o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição. * O cubo com o qual você vai competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele. Caso contrário, o cubo pode não ser aceito para a competição. * Não há idade mínima ou máxima para participação, mas competidores menores de 18 anos só podem participar com a presença de um responsável legal. * Todos os competidores devem apresentar documento válido com foto no credenciamento. * Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. Mande suas dúvidas para para o e-mail da organização (cascavelaocubo@gmail.com), e faremos o melhor possível para ajudar. Sempre há espaço para novos competidores! * Divirta-se! --- ##### 🇺🇸 Welcome to **Cascavel ao Cubo 2026**! Participation instructions: * All information regarding registration can be found in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CascavelaoCubo2026/register) tab. * Registration closes on **10/02/2026**, or whenever the **limit of 50 competitors** is reached. After that, it will only be possible to register for the 3x3x3 Cube event, in the day of the competition, if there are still vacancies. * Be present at the competition venue, in possession of your cube, at least 30 minutes earlier for any event you are participating. * All participants must read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. * The cube with which you will compete must be in good condition, so take good care of it. Otherwise, your cube may not be approved for the competition. * There is no minimum or maximum age for participation, but underage competitors can only participate with the presence of a legal guardian. * All competitors must present a valid document at the check-in. * If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. You can e-mail your questions to the organization (cascavelaocubo@gmail.com), and we will do our best to help you. There is always room for new speedcubers! * Have fun!

items.information: Cashmere Open 2023 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.
